notes.title: Permanent price drop on Yahrit!
notes.notes: Yahrit! has been out for a year now and we'd like to celebrate it's birthday with a permanent price drop. The new price should go live in the upcoming days, so if you're looking to buy Yahrit!, you might want to wait a little and get a better deal. Thanks to everyone who supported Yahrit! so far!

notes.title: Content Update: New Stage
notes.notes: We've updated Yahrit! with a new stage - Stronghold - which comes with its unique setting and a new feature that we hope will make the game more fun. We've also added a new music track for a little more diversity.

notes.title: Playing Yahrit! online
notes.notes: Have you heard of Parsec? It's a pretty awesome streaming app that effectively allows you to play local multiplayer games online. The installation is quick and easy, and the experience is really great. Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/862370/discussions/0/1761356057403267538/]this thread[/url] for more information on how to use Parsec.

notes.title: Yahrit! is now available!
notes.notes: And goes with a 10% discount! Grab a few friends, some controllers and enjoy this awesome new party brawler!
